name: FUSeg2021
description: Binary foot ulcer segmentation, labeled release pooled for five-fold CV.
patient_information_note: Release has no patient mapping; filenames are image IDs, not confirmed patient IDs.
split_group_rule: Identical image pixels at 256x256 share the smallest sample ID; native duplicates also checked. Not patient IDs.

preprocessing.mask_binarization: Existing loader rule: grayscale mask > 0, stored as uint8 {0,1}.
